name: OBS Studio
title: OBS Studio: free Streamlabs Ultra alternative
caption:
Streamlabs Ultra charges $189/year. OBS Studio streams and records for free 🎮

✅ Stream live to Twitch, YouTube and more
✅ Record your games and screen
✅ Unlimited scenes with webcam, game, text and browser sources
✅ Audio mixer with noise suppression, plus Studio Mode to preview before going live

💻 Windows · Mac · Linux
ℹ️ OBS is free for streaming and recording, but it has no built-in multistreaming, overlay library or cloud storage, which Streamlabs Ultra sells. Streamlabs' $189 is the yearly plan ($27 if paid monthly)

Comment "STREAM" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day

dm_pitch: OBS Studio, the free open-source way to stream and record 🎮

beats.say: If you pay Streamlabs to go live, stop scrolling.
You're paying for something that's free.
Streamlabs Ultra is a hundred and eighty nine dollars a year. OBS costs nothing.
Stack your game, webcam, text and browser windows into scenes, and go live.
Every mic gets its own filters, like noise suppression.
Go live on Twitch and YouTube, or just record.
Streamlabs is literally built on top of it.
Comment Stream, and I'll send you the link.
